name: Riley
goal: Riley hopes to find a university group project theme that sparks meaningful discussions and fosters a sense of camaraderie among team members.
backstory: Riley has worked on several group projects in computer science, including a recent project on machine learning that they led to great success. They prefer projects with real-world applications and have a soft spot for those involving natural language processing. Having seen how a well-chosen theme can boost team morale, Riley values themes that excite the whole group.

name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes to find a university group project theme that not only challenges their own assumptions but also leaves room for constructive debate and exploration of unconventional ideas.
backstory: Quinn has always been fascinated by the intersection of computer science and social impact, having worked on a project that used machine learning to predict student outcomes in underprivileged schools. They have a soft spot for projects that involve natural language processing and have spent countless hours exploring its applications. Although they tend to avoid being the center of attention, Quinn loves to engage in thought-provoking discussions about the potential pitfalls of relying too heavily on technology.

name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to find a project theme that not only aligns with the interests of the group but also has the potential to make a positive impact on society, something they care about deeply.
backstory: Taylor has been involved in several group projects during their computer science coursework and really enjoyed the collaborative experience of working on a project about natural language processing, which sparked their interest in exploring more topics like artificial intelligence or data analytics for their university group project. They found that discussing ideas with teammates and learning from each other's strengths was incredibly valuable. Taylor personally prefers projects that have real-world applications and are interdisciplinary.
